rawScenePlan.title: Shelves Reconfigure
rawScenePlan.event: Long rows of shelving units unlock and rotate on concealed rails; checkout counters slide together to form a continuous metal conveyor that cuts across the atrium, linking ground floor to the base of the escalator. Store lighting snaps to a colder, worklight tone as the furniture becomes a production line.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a new metal conveyor runs through the atrium, its rails inset into the floor leaving twin polished grooves
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Interior of the Kaufhaus atrium: tiered balconies and glass railings unchanged, but ground-floor shelving rotated into a continuous metal conveyor running across polished tile; cold white worklights cast sharp shadows; no people in frame; no text or logos.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: A slow push from the far atrium edge toward the new conveyor as shelving panels unlatch and rotate into place; hydraulic seams click, the conveyor's metal plates mesh and the lights flick to work-white; sound of motors and a single metallic clank.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: after the shelving finishes rotating, the camera dollies along the new conveyor at hip level to reveal the twin polished grooves in the floor

rawScenePlan.title: The Smear
rawScenePlan.event: Boxes and blank-wrapped parcels riding the conveyor begin to rupture along seam-lines; from each tear emerges fibrous, wet red material that pulses faintly like muscle, spreading into a fibrous smear across the metal plates. A store clerk drops a package and staggers back, leaving a handprint on the smear.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a long, fibrous red smear streaks across the conveyor plates and a single bloody handprint marks the nearest pallet
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Close-up of the Kaufhaus conveyor: blank parcels split open revealing fibrous, wet-red material that spreads across metal plates; a clear handprint stains the edge of a pallet; cold overhead worklights highlight the glossy texture; no people visible beyond a dropped glove.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Tight tracking shot along the conveyor as one parcel's seam bursts and wet fibers unfurl, the smear pulling across the metal plates; a clerk's gloved hand slaps the pallet and leaves a red print; the conveyor hums steadily beneath it.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: after the seam bursts, the camera tilts down to linger on the spreading handprint then pulls back along the smear to show its length

rawScenePlan.title: Afterimage Stalker
rawScenePlan.event: Overhead fluorescents begin to refract into long chromatic trails that hang in the air like translucent ribbons; the fibrous smear on the conveyor refracts too and emits phosphorescent afterimages. Those afterimages thicken and momentarily coalesce into a low-slung quadruped creature — leathered, low to the ground, with patches of mirror-like platelets along its spine and an elongated muzzle — which steps lightly across the metal plates, leaving small glowing prints, then dissolves back into ribbons.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a row of small phosphorescent pawprints runs down the conveyor and a cluster of refracted light ribbons hangs above it
rawScenePlan.nextHook: phosphorescent pawprints and hanging light ribbons
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Medium shot of the Kaufhaus conveyor under fluorescent arrays: ribbons of chromatic afterimage hang in the air and a sequence of small phosphorescent pawprints dots the metal plates; the creature that made them is momentarily visible as a low-slung quadruped with leathered skin and mirror-like platelets along its spine, then vanishes into light.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Low-angle tracking as chromatic trails stretch from the lights and the camera follows the ribbons until they coalesce into the brief appearance of a small quadruped (leathered hide, mirror-like dorsal plates, elongated muzzle) that pads along the conveyor and leaves glowing prints before dissolving into afterimage ribbons.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: after the creature appears and steps, a slow low tracking shot follows its paws to show the glowing prints, then cranes up to reveal the hanging ribbons

rawScenePlan.title: Collective Choreography
rawScenePlan.event: Shoppers on the floor begin to repeat short clipped phrases aloud — the H- and P-like syllables — and fall into synchronized movement: carts line up bumper-to-bumper, shoppers step in unison and form a moving human barricade that shifts down the conveyor's length. Shoes scuff through the phosphorescent pawprints, leaving faint glowing streaks on tile.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a human barricade of interlocked carts blocks the conveyor; glowing streaks crisscross the floor where shoes scuffed through prints
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Wide shot of the Kaufhaus ground floor: a dense human barricade of shoppers and shopping carts aligned along the conveyor, all stepping in locked choreography; their shoes scuff glowing streaks into the tile where phosphorescent prints had been; no monster visible.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Overhead crane shot that descends as shoppers chant clipped syllables and fall into synchronized steps; carts click together to form a moving barrier and shoes smear faint glowing streaks across tile as the barricade advances.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: after the choreography forms, an overhead crane pulls back to show the barricade length and the glowing streaks across the floor

rawScenePlan.title: Shower and Scorch
rawScenePlan.event: The human barricade jerks as a suspended bank of industrial lights detonates in a cascade of incandescent bulbs; falling globes shatter, sending sparks and a brief wall of smoke; carts are sent spinning and several topple. From an upper balcony the same low-slung quadruped (leathered skin, mirror-like dorsal plates, elongated muzzle) springs down into the smoke, knocking a canister into the conveyor; heat scorches the metal and leaves a dark crescent scorch on the plates.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a crescent-shaped scorch mark scorches the conveyor plates, a haze of smoke lingers in the atrium, and several overturned carts lie scattered
rawScenePlan.nextHook: scorched crescent, lingering smoke, overturned carts
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Chaotic mid-action still: a shower of shattered incandescent bulbs falls through the Kaufhaus atrium, a haze of smoke begins to spread; several carts lie overturned and a crescent scorch darkens the metal conveyor plates; the quadruped creature (low-slung, leathered skin, mirror-like plates along its spine) is visible slipping between carts.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: High-speed pan as a rig of industrial lights collapses into a shower of glass and sparks; a smoke wave rolls through the atrium, carts spin and topple; the quadruped creature leaps from an upper balcony into the smoke and knocks a small canister onto the conveyor, which immediately scorches where it lands.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: after the bulbs shatter, a high-speed pan follows the falling glass, then cuts to a low-angle shot on the scorched conveyor as smoke curls around the creature's silhouette

rawScenePlan.title: Transactions
rawScenePlan.event: Tills and card terminals embedded into the conveyor plates click open like mechanical mouths; the overturned carts and scattered objects are compulsively fed into those openings by shoppers who now move with an automated efficiency. The tills process smoke and scorch-marked fragments, spitting out neat stacks of small, faceless tokens. The quadruped creature sits at the conveyor's center and presses a glowing pawprint into a token; the token falls into a circular hole in the floor which hums and polishes the surrounding tile, leaving a single fading phosphorescent print.
rawScenePlan.consequence: a neat circular hole in the floor emits a soft hum and the surrounding tile is polished; one fading phosphorescent pawprint remains at the hole's edge
rawScenePlan.nextHook: polished circular hole and fading pawprint
rawScenePlan.stillPrompt: Frontal still of the Kaufhaus center: tills embedded in the conveyor open like mechanical mouths and spit out small faceless tokens; shoppers feed carts and scorched debris into them; at center the quadruped creature (leathered hide, mirror-like dorsal plates, elongated muzzle) presses a glowing pawprint into a token beside a humming circular hole in the floor; one phosphorescent print fades at the hole's rim.
rawScenePlan.videoPrompt: Slow, deliberate dolly in as tills click and swallow overturned carts and debris, spitting out tidy tokens; shoppers feed the machines with money-like motion; the creature places its glowing pawprint on a token, drops it into the humming circular hole which polishes the tile edges and the last phosphorescent print fades.
rawScenePlan.cameraCue: after the creature presses the pawprint, a tight close-up on the print as it fades, then a slow pull back to reveal the humming circular hole and the polished floor around it
